articles.title_en: Russian strikes knock out three of Ukraine’s largest steel plants
articles.lead_en: Russian missile strikes have knocked out three of Ukraine’s largest steel plants, putting the country’s entire steel industry at risk, the Financial Times reported in an article examining how Russian attacks are battering Ukraine’s economy.
